note: simulate --broadcast delivers reports through MockKeystoneForwarder. On CRE CLI v1.39, `cre workflow supported-chains --output json` puts that value in mockAddress. The address field is the production KeystoneForwarder; using it as this constructor makes onReport revert NotForwarder. The deploy script reads mockAddress unless FORWARDER is set. KeystoneForwarder is only for cre workflow deploy.
